# Identify your MacBook Pro model

Use this information to find out which MacBook Pro you have, and where it fits in the history of MacBook Pro.

## Find the name of your Mac model

The easiest way to find the name of your Mac model is to choose About This Mac from the Apple menu  in the corner of your screen. Learn more about how to find your Mac model name or serial number, even when you don’t have your Mac or it doesn’t start up all the way.

## MacBook Pro (14-inch, M5 Pro or M5 Max)

Image: MacBook Pro (14-inch, M5 Pro or M5 Max) in Silver and Space Black.

This model has the M5 Pro or M5 Max chip and includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports.

Year introduced: 2026

Colors: Silver, Space Black

Model Identifier: Mac17,7, Mac17,9

Newest compatible operating system: macOS 27 Golden Gate

Part Numbers: MGDN4xx/A, MGDP4xx/A, MGDQxx/A, MGDR4xx/A, MGDT4xx/A, MGDU4xx/A
